entries.category: Release Available: Client Connector 4.7.0.394 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.7.0.394 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Updates Zscaler Client Connector to exclude compromised TLS intermediate certificates associated with digital certificate provider eMudhra when loading root certificates. To learn more, see the trust post.
Fixes an issue where the ZSATrayManager process could crash during Machine Tunnel enrollment when required Windows machine registration data was missing or malformed in the registry instead of failing gracefully as designed.
Updates the ZEP (Zscaler Endpoint Protection) module used for anti-tampering protection to the latest version (26.08.1.10).
Fixes an issue where, if a machine tunnel was running, users received a Something went wrong error on their first attempt when trying to reset their Windows PIN and the users had to go back and re-initiate the I forgot my PIN process.
Fixes an issue where flow logs for bypassed traffic could intermittently stop recording when the client's egress IP could not be resolved due to network issues.

entries.category: Release Available: Client Connector 4.8.0.295 for macOS
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.8.0.295 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Updates Zscaler Client Connector to exclude compromised TLS intermediate certificates associated with digital certificate provider eMudhra when loading root certificates. To learn more, see the trust post.
Supports always allowing IPv6 in dual stack networks in Transparent Proxy-based Interception mode to prevent high CPU usage on devices regardless of the Drop IPv6 in Dual Stack Network setting in a user’s forwarding profile.
Fixes an issue where VPN (for Legacy Apps) stayed stuck in a Connecting state and prevented users from accessing Private Access applications until the device was restarted.
Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector in FIPS mode failed to connect to captive portals on public Wi-Fi networks.
Fixes an issue where Kerberos-based authentication was failing for single sign-on for internal domains using Private Access due to DNS issues.
Fixes an issue where internet traffic was allowed while the tunnel was being established on devices in Strict Enforcement mode after a user logged in to Zscaler Client Connector in Transparent Proxy-based Interception mode.
Fixes an issue where a user was automatically logged out of Zscaler Client Connector and received a Service has been administratively disabled error.
Fixes an issue where a user did not receive an advance Private Access reauthentication notification after their device woke up from sleep.
Fixes an issue where Private Access routes remained in the routing table after Private Access was turned off in Route-based Interception mode.
Fixes an issue where Siri AI requests on macOS 27 Golden Gate versions were intermittently failing when Zscaler Client Connector was actively tunneling traffic.

entries.category: Feature Available
entries.title: Increased Archive Scan Depth with Advanced Sandbox
entries.text:
With Advanced Sandbox, you can scan archive files with up to 10 nested archives for threats. To increase the archive scan depth, contact your Zscaler Account team.
To learn more, see About Sandbox.

entries.category: Feature in Limited Availability
entries.title: Enterprise Browser for Mobile
entries.text:
Enterprise Browser for Zero Trust Browser is available as a native mobile application for iOS, iPadOS, and Android. On a personal or corporate phone or tablet, the Enterprise Browser mobile app provides a governed workspace that enforces policy, prevents data loss, and protects users from everyday browser-based threats.
Distribution of the app depends on whether the device is personal, corporate managed, or enrolled in a bring-your-own-device (BYOD) program. Users can install the app from the App Store or Google Play, or admins can push the app to users via your organization's Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Mobile Application Management (MAM) platform.
To learn more, see Understanding Enterprise Browser for Mobile.

entries.category: Feature Available
entries.title: Advanced SSPM Support for Adobe Acrobat Sign
entries.text:
Advanced SSPM supports a new platform, Adobe Acrobat Sign. You can onboard an Adobe Acrobat Sign tenant from the 3rd-Party App Governance Admin Portal.
To learn more, see Integrating with Adobe Acrobat Sign and Connecting Your Platforms to Advanced SSPM.

entries.category: Feature Available
entries.title: Advanced SSPM Support for Kintone
entries.text:
Advanced SSPM supports a new platform, Kintone. You can onboard a Kintone tenant from the 3rd-Party App Governance Admin Portal.
To learn more, see Integrating with Kintone and Connecting Your Platforms to Advanced SSPM.

entries.category: Feature Available
entries.title: Hardware Security Module Support for Enrollment Certificates
entries.text:
You can store both public and private keys for enrollment certificates and certificate signing requests (CSRs) in hardware security modules (HSMs) when generating an enrollment certificate or creating a CSR.
To learn more, see About Enrollment (CA) Certificates, Generating Zscaler-issued Enrollment (CA) Certificates, and Creating Certificate Signing Requests for Enrollment (CA) Certificates.

entries.category: Feature in Limited Availability
entries.title: Manager and Software Version Information Available for Groups
entries.text:
The Manager software and component software version appears when you hover over the information icon under Version Profile on the App Connector Groups, Private Service Edge Groups, Private Cloud Controller Groups, and Network Connector Groups pages in the Zscaler Admin Console.
To learn more, see About App Connector Groups, About Private Service Edge Groups, About Private Cloud Controller Groups, and About Network Connector Groups.

entries.category: Feature in Limited Availability
entries.title: Private Cloud Controller Upgrade Priority
entries.text:
If Private Cloud Controllers are included in version profile assignments, they must be a higher or equal version to the assigned Private Service Edge or App Connector. An error message appears on the Private Cloud Controllers page in the Zscaler Admin Console to reinforce this.
The Version Mismatch filter is available on the Private Cloud Controllers page to display version profiles that are mismatched in relation to Private Cloud Controllers.
To learn more, see About Private Cloud Controllers.

entries.category: Feature in Limited Availability
entries.title: Autonomous Application Shield
entries.text:
The Autonomous Application Shield feature allows you to scan private applications for vulnerabilities that you can apply AppProtection controls to. You can schedule scans based on frequency and intensity. You can review the protection analytics and the scan specifics in the Zscaler Admin Console.
To learn more, see:
About Autonomous Application Shield
About App Connectors
Editing a Deployed App Connector
About AppProtection Controls

entries.category: Feature in Limited Availability
entries.title: Support for Nested Criteria, NOT Operators, and Bulk Actions in Global Rules and Policy Groups
entries.text:
Private Access (ZPA) added the following updates for global rules and policy groups to simplify the management of application access policies:
Added support for building nested criteria sets when configuring rules with SAML or SCIM Attributes or Client Connector Posture Profiles.
Added support for applying AND NOT and OR NOT logic operators when configuring rules with SAML or SCIM Attributes or Client Connector Posture Profiles.
Added support for bulk move and delete rules within policy groups.
To learn more, see:
About Access Policies for Global Rules
About Access Policies for Policy Groups
Configuring Access Policies for Global Rules and Policy Groups

entries.category: Feature in Limited Availability
entries.title: Smaller Hardware Appliances for App Connectors
entries.text:
Smaller form factor ZPA appliances are available for App Connectors with 1G throughput. This hardware appliance can be rack mounted or wall mounted (available upon request).
To learn more, see:
Understanding ZPA Appliances
ZPA Appliance Wall and Rack Mount Instruction Manual
ZPA Appliance Physical Port Mapping
